username.description: The provider accepts any value. This value is sent as the Basic username; the API key is its password.
username.title: Basic Username

expected_organisation_name.description: Optional exact name to match against account/info during connection and account reads. No organization ID is required.
expected_organisation_name.title: Expected Organization Name

ESputnikAPIKeyCredential.title: Yespo API Key
ESputnikAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Use an existing eSputnik/Yespo API key as the HTTP Basic password. Any username is accepted by the provider; the default is noclick. This is not your account password or an event Bearer token. Connection reads account/info and shows the returned organization name and user email; it does not prove contact/broadcast permissions, entitlement or subscription status.

operation.description: Read the protected userEmail and organisationName witness. An orgId is included only if returned; this does not prove access to other operations.
operation.title: Get Account Info

operation.description: Read the documented additionalFieldsLists structure, including field keys, types, allowed values and validation metadata. No contact values are fetched.
operation.title: Get Contact Field Schema

operation.description: Read one exact broadcast metadata record. This does not fetch its message, recipients, content or delivery report.
operation.title: Get Broadcast

broadcast_id.description: Exact string ID from List Broadcasts. Custom entry only; no unsupported picker or ancestry endpoint is invoked.
broadcast_id.title: Broadcast ID

include_personal_data.description: Include names and email/SMS/Viber channel values. These are personal data; push tokens, device data, addresses and URLs are never returned.
include_personal_data.title: Include Contact Details

include_additional_values.description: Include documented field ID/string-value pairs. Custom field values can contain sensitive information.
include_additional_values.title: Include Additional Field Values

operation.description: Read an exact contact ID under the current API key. The card does not return global blacklist or full email subscription status.
operation.title: Get Contact

contact_id.description: Exact provider contact ID. Enter a known ID or copy it from Search Contacts; no invented segment or account ancestry is asserted.
contact_id.title: Contact ID

operation.description: Read broadcast metadata, without fetching message content or changing delivery. Full pages indicate only that another page may exist.
operation.title: List Broadcasts

start_index.description: Provider numbering starts at 1. Local maximum is 1,000,000; incoming or changed broadcasts can shift pages.
start_index.title: Start Index

max_rows.description: One page of 1–500 broadcasts. No automatic page traversal.
max_rows.title: Maximum Rows

include_personal_data.description: Include names and email/SMS/Viber channel values. These are personal data; push tokens, device data, addresses and URLs are never returned.
include_personal_data.title: Include Contact Details

include_additional_values.description: Include documented field ID/string-value pairs. Custom field values can contain sensitive information.
include_additional_values.title: Include Additional Field Values

operation.description: Read one page from GET /contacts. At least one documented search condition is required locally; this operation does not perform a bulk contact export or establish suppression status.
operation.title: Search Contacts

start_index.description: Provider numbering starts at 1. Local maximum is 1,000,000; pages are not a consistent snapshot.
start_index.title: Start Index

max_rows.description: One page of 1–500 contact cards. No automatic page traversal.
max_rows.title: Maximum Rows

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
